name: Youkoso♪ Seerua Gakuen Nakadashi Festival
original_name: ようこそ♪ セールア学園中出しフェスティバル
source:
Welcome to Se-rua Academy Creampie Festival! Yosuke Ichinose is the new student council president of the elite school, Se-rua Academy. Tasked with the responsibility of keeping the hardworking students happy and healthy, Yosuke devises an ingenious plan to bring the boys and girls "closer" in his great Creampie Festival: a week-long celebration paying tribute to legendary sex folktales from ancient Japan, lived out through the festival's several mini-events. This, he believes, will ultimately solve Se-rua's dysfunctional relationship woes and bring more "Fruit of Love" (e.g. babies) to the world.

Yosuke can't succeed all by himself which is why his all-female student council team is there to “help” him make it to the end. You'll meet Ms. Matsunaga (the bubbly vice president), Sango (the straight-faced secretary) and Suzuka (the aggravated accountant). As you progress through Creampie Festival, you'll learn more about these girls -- personal things -- that reveal some complexity that isn’t apparent on the surface. Also, you’ll discover other adorable characters that will affect the outcome of Se-rua and Yosuke's future. With multiple routes and endings to enjoy, Welcome to Se-rua Academy Creampie Festival is a hormonally charged visual novel that will keep you entertained with its lighthearted humor and abundant sex encounters. Original Japanese voices have been kept intact to keep things aurally authentic. There’s also a cute theme song and some animation to boot.

So c’mon! You’re invited to Creampie Festival. How will you choose to make it through this wild week of events and reverse the students’ intimacy problems? 

(Note: players with high blood pressure should play with caution.)

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200513002753/https://mikandi.com/app/16584]MiKandi[/url]]
